what_is_it.heading: Ukuxhalaba ngamazwi acacileyo
what_is_it.lede: Ixhala yinto oyivayo xa isixokelelwano somzimba wakho sidubula rhoqo, sikhwaza kakhulu, okanye kungekho ngozi yokwenyani. Wonke umntu uziva exhalabile ngamanye amaxesha. Ingxaki yokuxhalaba kuxa ingena kwindlela yobomi obuqhelekileyo.
paragraphs: Kukho iintlobo ezininzi: ukuxhalaba ngokubanzi (ukukhathazeka rhoqo), ukuhlaselwa luloyiko (amaza ngequbuliso oloyiko olukhulu), ixhala ekuhlaleni (uloyiko lokugwetywa), i-phobias ethile, i-PTSD emva kokwenzakala. Ziyadibana kwaye zabelana ngemigaqo yonyango.

Ukuxhalaba kunento eyomeleleyo yomzimba-intliziyo ebalekayo, ukubila, ukuphefumla kancinci, isiyezi, isicaphucaphu, ukungcangcazela. Umzimba uziva ngathi usengozini naxa ingqondo isazi ukuba akunjalo. Oku kuyinyani, hayi 'zonke entlokweni yakho'. Iyanyangeka.

items.headline: Ezixhaphake kakhulu
items.body: Ukuphazamiseka kokuxhalaba lelona qela lixhaphakileyo leemeko zempilo yengqondo kwihlabathi. Malunga nommi om-1 kwaba-5 waseMzantsi Afrika uye waba nengxaki enye ngaxa lithile.

items.headline: Iyanyangeka
items.body: I-Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), amayeza, kunye nokutshintsha kwendlela yokuphila kusebenza kakuhle kubantu abaninzi. Akunyanzelekanga ukuba uphile nayo.

items.headline: Nangokomzimba
items.body: Unxunguphalo luvakala emzimbeni - ukubetha kwentliziyo, ukuphefumla, isiyezi. Abantu bahlala becinga ukuba bahlaselwa yintliziyo. Ukuyiqonda into eyiyo kuyanceda.

items.headline: Uncedo lwasimahla
items.body: I-SADAG kunye neLifeLine zibonelela ngeengcebiso zasimahla zokuxhalaba. Iikliniki zibonelela ngovavanyo kunye nonyango lwasimahla. Uncedo lusondele kunokuba ucinga.

pull_quote.text: Ukuxhalaba akulophawu lokuba buthathaka. Luphawu lokuba isixokelelwano sakho se-alam sisebenza ixesha elongezelelekileyo. Iindaba ezimnandi: iinkqubo ze-alam zinokuphinda ziqeqeshwe.

signs.heading: Ixhala lijongeka njani
signs.lede: Ixhala libonakala ngeendlela ezintathu eziphambili - emzimbeni, engqondweni, nakwindlela yokuziphatha. Mhlawumbi uqaphela enye yazo.

items.title: Emzimbeni
items.description: Intliziyo ebalekayo, ukuphefumla ngokukhawuleza okanye ukuziva ungakwazi ukubamba umoya wakho, ukubila, ukungcangcazela, isicaphucaphu okanye isisu esibuhlungu, isiyezi, isifuba esiqinileyo, ukutshotshozela, ukutshisa okanye ukubanda.

items.title: Engqondweni
items.description: Ukuzikhathaza rhoqo - kwanangezinto ezincinci, ukoyika, ukubaleka kwengqondo, ukulindela okubi kakhulu, awukwazi kugxila, ukuxakekisa 'kunganjani' iingcinga, ubunzima bokulala.

items.title: Ekuziphatheni
items.description: Ukunqanda iimeko ezikwenza ube nexhala, ufuna ukuqinisekiswa rhoqo, ukujonga kunye nokujongwa kwakhona, ukucaphuka, ukurhoxa ebantwini, ukusebenzisa utywala okanye izinto zokuzola.

items.myth: Ukuxhalaba kukuxhalaba kakhulu nje. Yeka ukucinga ngokugqithiseleyo.
items.fact: Ukuphazamiseka kokuxhalaba kubandakanya utshintsho lokwenyani engqondweni nasemzimbeni - hayi nje iipatheni zokucinga. Ukuxelela umntu ukuba 'yeka ukuxhalaba' kufana nokuxelela umntu onesifo seswekile ukuba 'yilawule iswekile yakho'. Ayisebenzi.

items.myth: Iyeza lokuxhalaba liyakhobokisa kwaye likuguqule ube yi-zombie.
items.fact: Iyeza langoku lokulwa nokuxhalaba (i-SSRIs ngakumbi) alikhoboki. Ithulisa inkqubo ye-alamu ngokwaneleyo ukuba unyango kunye nezakhono zokujongana nazo zinokusebenza. Ayitshintshi into oyiyo.
Ukuxhalaba yimeko yonyango enotshintsho olunokulinganiswa kwikhemistri yengqondo, izinga lentliziyo, kunye namanqanaba ehomoni. Inyaniso yokuba abanye abayiboni ayithethi ukuba ayenzeki.

items.myth: Wakuba unexhala, uba nalo ubomi bonke.
items.fact: Uninzi lwabantu abafumana unyango olufanelekileyo lwexhala babona ukuphucuka okubonakalayo kwaye abaninzi babuyela ngokupheleleyo. Nokuba ukuxhalaba okukhulu kusabela kunyango kunye namayeza xa kunikwe ithuba.

items.title: Funda ukusetha kwakhona ukuphefumla
items.description: Xa ixhala likhula: phefumlela ngaphakathi kwizibalo ezi-4, bambelela kwi-4, ngaphandle kwe-6. Yisebenzise ngexesha lokuphakuzela - isebenza ngaphakathi komzuzu.

items.title: Yichaze xa uyiva
items.description: Ukuthi 'oku kuxhalaba, hayi ukuhlaselwa yintliziyo' kunceda ukwahlula isivusi somzimba kwingozi yokwenyani. Yehlisa i-panic-mayelana-panic spiral.

items.title: Sika icaffeine ukuba unako
items.description: I-caffeine ilinganisa ngokuthe ngqo iimpawu zokuxhalaba - intliziyo ebalekayo, i-jitteriness. Abantu abaninzi babona ukuphucuka okukhulu kwiiveki ezi-2-3 zokunciphisa okanye ukuyeka.

items.title: Yiya ekliniki uyokwenza uvavanyo
items.description: Iiklinikhi zikarhulumente zibonelela ngovavanyo lwasimahla lwempilo yengqondo. Thetha nomongikazi wezempilo yengqondo. Uncedo olusekelwe kwi-CBT kunye namayeza ukuba ayafuneka asimahla.

items.title: Ukuba luhlaselo lovalo ngokukodwa
items.description: Funda malunga nolawulo lokuhlaselwa kwe-panic - ukwazi ipateni (incopho kwi-10 min, ingaze ibe yingozi, ihlala idlula) ithatha uninzi loloyiko kubo.

get_help.heading: Ngubani omawubize
get_help.lede: Ukuxhalaba kuphendula kakuhle kakhulu kunyango. Eyona nto inzima kukufikelela okokuqala. I-SADAG kunye neLifeLine zenza kube lula oko - simahla, iyimfihlo, akukho sigwebo.
